jobs.description: JOIN US Ab sofort suchen wir für unser Team am Standort Stuttgart oder Berlin einen Creative Strategist (all genders). Werde Teil unserer Community – wir freuen uns auf dich! WHAT YOU DO Analyse von Marken, Zielgruppen und kulturellen Shifts zur Ableitung fundierter strategischer Sprungbretter ( Creative Briefings ). Entwicklung von integrierten Kommunikations- und Aktivierungskonzepten für Raum, Event, Social Media und digitale Ökosysteme. jobs.title: Senior Level Designer
jobs.description: Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line. With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years. This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles. What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones. At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment. The opportunity You’ll be the keeper of the player experience on our hybrid casual RPG. Combat, heroes, art, and features all come together in the levels you build, and you decide whether that adds up to something players want to come back to. You’ll join a small, AI-native game team on its way to launch. You’ll own the level design area completely: you set the roadmap, make the calls, and ship.

jobs.description: Envie de rejoindre une équipe dynamique et créative au cœur d’un Groupe associatif engagé ? Rejoignez Réunir ! Qui sommes-nous ? Réunir est un Groupe Associatif incontournable du transport routier de voyageurs, auquel adhèrent plus de 200 PME à travers la France. Notre mission : accompagner nos adhérents, mutualiser les compétences et renforcer leur compétitivité, tout en préservant leur indépendance. 4 structures complémentaires forment l’écosystème de Réunir : Réunir Association, Syneo, Saybus et Réunir Assurances. Le service Marketing et Communication est garant de l’image de marque, de la notoriété de Réunir, de ses filiales et de ses Adhérents. Nous recherchons aujourd’hui un.e Designer Multimédia enthousiaste et créatif.ve, prêt.e à accompagner la Directrice Marketing et Communication dans le déploiement de la stratégie du service et du groupe associatif. Vos missions Vos principales missions : Supports de communication print, Direction artistique & identité visuelle Concevoir et décliner des identités visuelles et des campagnes de communication pour nos événements et ponctuellement pour nos adhérents. Imaginer et créer les univers graphiques de nos salons professionnels tel que IFTM, Autocars Expo, Mobco…(stands, habillages de murs, supports de communication, signalétique, déclinaisons print et digitales.) Concevoir l'identité visuelle de notre congrès annuel, le congrès de l’avenir réunir. Assurer le pilotage de la chaîne graphique : sélection et négociation avec les imprimeurs, validation des BAT, suivi de fabrication, contrôle qualité et coordination des différents intervenants jusqu'à la livraison des supports. Créer des contenus et supports de communication interne (contenus pour les TV d’entreprises, courriers, affiches, bandeaux mails, visuels et autres supports institutionnels.) 📱 Création de contenus digitaux Créer des visuels pour les réseaux sociaux. Décliner de campagnes digitales. Créer d'illustrations, infographies et supports de communication.

We have bike enthusiasts, foodies, video game heroes, dog and cat lovers, movie buffs, musicians, and every variety of people. In this role, you’ll support the delivery of creative campaigns and develop compelling motion content for a range of internal and external projects across multiple channels. You’ll play an important role in building a consistent global brand identity and creating work that informs, inspires, and connects with audiences, helping position Lightspeed as a leading commerce platform for businesses worldwide. What you’ll be doing: Create engaging video content for social media, advertising, brand campaigns, product demos, events and more. Support the creative team with animation, motion graphics, audio selection, colour correction and video editing. Adapt and optimise video content for different channels and platforms. Develop storyboards to bring creative concepts to life from start to finish. Maintain brand consistency and high-quality standards across all motion content. Collaborate with content creators and key stakeholders to develop and deliver creative ideas. Contribute to brainstorming sessions and explore new creative opportunities. Manage project timelines and meet deadlines with guidance from the project manager. What you need to bring: We're looking for a candidate who has experience with the following: A strong portfolio showcasing creativity and high-quality work. Previous experience in motion desig

jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.description: Who we are Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond. Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it. We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career. If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you. Your Impact Help Scout has earned something most software companies never get: genuine trust. 10,000+ businesses use us because we've always believed that customer relationships are the business, and that every interaction should feel like it came from someone who cares. That trust took a decade to build, and now it's the foundation for something bigger. A lot of that trust is design. When customers tell us why they picked Help Scout over the alternatives, and when they recommend us to someone else, the reason they give most often is that it is easier to use and it feels better to work in. That's why our top source for new customers comes from human and agent referrals. Our user experience is one of the strongest advantages we have, and as Director of Product Design you'll be directly accountable for keeping our quality high as we accelerate our growth. jobs.description: NUR VOLLZEIT! Du hast ein Auge für Design, das andere nicht haben, denkst Marketing immer mit und willst mit einem Team Gas geben, dem gestandene D2C-Brands ihren kompletten Auftritt im Postfach blind anvertrauen? Klingt gut? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Hey, wir sind Bendt Brothers. Zwei Brüder, ein Fokus: E-Mail-Marketing wieder sexy machen. Weg von Rabatt-Spam und Template-Langeweile, hin zu Mails, auf die sich Kunden freuen und die richtig verkaufen. Bei uns arbeitest du nicht am Fließband. Es geht nicht darum, Tickets abzuhaken, damit die nächste Mail rausgeht, egal wie sie performt. Stattdessen trägst du maßgeblich dazu bei, dass unsere Kunden neue Rekorde aufstellen , Grenzen verschieben und ihre eigenen Erwartungen übertreffen. Und das nicht für irgendwelche Shops, sondern für Marken, die du wirklich kennst: mymuesli, Pammys, zeroLabs, Supernaturals, FAVLY und viele mehr. Aufgaben Hast du Bock auf verstaubte Asana-Boards und chaotische Canva-Projekte? Wir auch nicht. Was du stattdessen machst: Du designst Mails in Figma , die man am liebsten einrahmen möchte. Du gestaltest Kampagnen, Flows und Pop-ups für Marken , die man aus dem Alltag kennt Du baust WhatsApp-Banner , bei denen keiner weiterscrollt, und Print-Mailings , die nicht im Altpapier landen. Du arbeitest mit modernen KI-Systemen , die dir die Fleißarbeit abnehmen. Qualifikation Fähigkeiten & Erfahrung Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind unerlässlich. Du arbeitest seit 1+ Jahren mit Figma Du bist digital versiert , arbeitest strukturiert und denkst analytisch. Nice-to-have: Du hast bereits Erfahrung im E-Commerce-Umfeld und kennst dich mit Klaviyo aus. Einstellung & Herangehensweise Du übernimmst 100% Verantwortung für deine Ergebnisse. Du denkst in Lösungen statt in Problemen und gibst dich nicht mit Mittelmaß zufrieden. Du liebst es, dich persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Du willst, dass unsere Kunden erfolgreich sind, und gehst dafür auch mal die Extrameile. Benefits Was dich

jobs.title: Staff Design Engineer - Americas
jobs.description: Hi I’m Abhik , Ashby 's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year. This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that. You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have: Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI. Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily. Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies. Depuis 2006, Ekimetrics aide les organisations à transformer leurs décisions en avantage concurrentiel durable grâce à des solutions d’IA. Notre double ambition est d’allier performance et durabilité, pour construire un leadership pérenne. Nos solutions sont une combinaison unique de People et de technologie. Notre plateforme Eki.Decisions complète l’expertise de nos équipes en marketing, efficacité commerciale et data science, pour connecter l’IA aux décisions qui structurent toute l’organisation. Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un avantage concurrentiel constant, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN.
